name: JoyCaption-Beta-One
description: JoyCaption Beta One - LLaVA-based image captioning model, trained on 2.4M samples

prompts.detailed: Write a detailed description of this image, focusing on the subject, composition, lighting, colors, mood, and artistic style.
prompts.short: Write a brief one-sentence caption for this image.
prompts.tags: List descriptive tags for this image, separated by commas. Include subject, style, mood, colors, and composition.
prompts.analyze: Analyze this image's composition, lighting, color palette, and artistic style. What makes this image visually interesting?

system_prompt: You are a helpful image captioner.
